title: Assets saved in 2024 not being copied over to 2025
content:
If you have custom poses or fabrics/whatever you saved into the documents clo asset folder, for example I save poses in the avatar pose folder. You have to manually copy them back over to the new CLO Asset folder for 2025.

If you switch from the new library to the old one you have to manually add the folder back as well.
content_description: This webpage provides essential instructions for transferring custom poses and fabrics to the new CLO Asset folder for 2025, ensuring a seamless transition between library versions.

title: Measuring On Avatar With Feedback Line
content:
**Question 1:**

I want to take measurements on the avatar with the following options:

A) **Surface Distance:** Curved measurement that follows the contours of the body surface.

B) **Straight Line Distance:** Straight (air) measurement between two points.

**Question 2:**

While taking these measurements, I want a measurement line to appear.

Even better, I want this line to stay visible (a feedback line) so I can clearly see exactly where the measurement was taken.

**Question 3:**

If there is a measurement list, I want the measurements to be saved there.

**How can I do all this?**

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi! You can do this with the Avatar Tape Measure Tool.👉 For surface distance (curved):Go to Avatar > Measure > Add Tape Measure (On Avatar) and click two points on the body — it follows the surface.👉 For straight (air) distance:Same tool — just select two points, and it will draw a straight line between them.The line should stay visible until you manually hide or delete it. You can control its visibility under Avatar Display > Tape Measure.And yes — the measurements are saved automatically in the Avatar Tape Measure List (check the Object Browser > Avatar > Tape Measure). You can rename, hide, or export them if you need.Hope this helps! 😊
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide on how to take and save accurate measurements on an avatar, including options for surface and straight line distances, with visible feedback lines for clarity.

title: How Can I Assign Keyboard Shorcuts Or Change For Panning?
content:
How Can I Assign Keyboard Shorcuts Or Change For Panning?

or zooming

Can I make a keyboard shortcut like these

Panning : CTRL + Arrow Keys

Rotate : ALT + Arrow Keys

etc.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi! You can change the control setting in Settings - User Settings - View Controls. But there are only the mouse buttons + Ctrl/Alt/Shift etc. Usually in 3D you always navigate with mouse+key or only mouse, haven't seen yet cases with arrows (only in gaming).

title: Unused pattern piece can not be deleted
content:
Hello,

In my recent project, I assigned fabric A for all pattern pieces. After I replaced them all by fabric B. As usual when all the pattern pieces has been assigned by other fabric, the old one could be deleted, but in my case, fabric A remains. I figured out that there is ONE piece that if delete it, fabric A will also delatable. Could someone please help me to explain why this is happening? How could I delete fabric A without deleting that pattern piece?

I'm looking for your help!![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/c3358d8cec9e4dd4a44b63ee9ad91b24/images/d8ce3584132d456cb1a2f91e635126c8z6689596605002_6be9f0a81e2189af466377587860da4c.jpg)![01c8d6e86797481abbf3d4d64ec62dbe](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/c3358d8cec9e4dd4a44b63ee9ad91b24/images/01c8d6e86797481abbf3d4d64ec62dbeimage.png)![8d012d4a826142aca75160711c38c216](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/c3358d8cec9e4dd4a44b63ee9ad91b24/images/8d012d4a826142aca75160711c38c216z6689596605002_6be9f0a81e2189af466377587860da4c.jpg)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hello, thanks for your reply. I've check on that pattern, but the thing is, that pattern piece was duplicated using filler, why don't both of 2 piece stored the same fabric data? Additionally, there's no internal line or topstitch... to be assigned.

Comment 2: Maybe itrelates to how fabric assignment metadata is stored in pattern pieces.Fabric A is still assigned somewhere in that single pattern piece — likely in a hidden or non-obvious way. Here are the possible causes:1.Fabric Assigned to the Back Side Only:In CLO/MD, pattern pieces have both Front and Back sides. Even if you assign Fabric B to the Front, the Back might still be using Fabric A.You can check this in the Property Editor > Fabric > Side > Back.2.Fabric Assigned to Internal Lines or Bindings:If there are internal lines (for piping, topstitching, etc.) or binding/edge finishes, they can retain the old fabric.These details may not be visible unless explicitly selected.3.Fabric Assigned to a Graphic or Topstitching Element:Sometimes textures or stitching details retain fabric links independently.
Reply 1: Hello, jumping in to clear up that point 1 and 3 are incorrect and impossible. Point 2 made is correct and could be a cause.
content_description: This web page aims to seek assistance in understanding why fabric A cannot be deleted from a project despite all pattern pieces being reassigned to fabric B, and how to resolve this issue without affecting a specific pattern piece.
